proposals.before: Changle, Prince of Anle, was made Prince of Changchang in Huangxing year 4 and later transferred to Anle.
proposals.after: Changle, Prince of Anle, was made Prince of Jianchang in Huangxing year 4 and later transferred to Anle.
proposals.reason: 建昌 is Jianchang, not Changchang; the English fief name is corrupted.

proposals.before: Early in Yanzhang, in a year of great famine, Yanming spent his household wealth to save several dozen guests and support their families as well.
proposals.after: Early in Yanchang, in a year of great famine, Yanming spent his household wealth to save several dozen guests and support their families as well.
proposals.reason: 延昌 is Yanchang, not Yanzhang.

proposals.before: He, Prince of Zhongshan Xi, and his younger brother Prince of Linhuai Yu were among those whose learning and reputation shone across the age.
proposals.after: He, Prince of Zhongshan Xi, and Xi's younger brother Prince of Linhuai Yu were among those whose learning and reputation shone across the age.
proposals.reason: 弟臨淮王彧 is Xi's younger brother; English his is ambiguous and may attach to Yanming.

proposals.before: When the Deposed Emperor came to the throne he was posthumously titled grand mentor, his princedom left as before, with the temple name Prince Wenzuan.
proposals.after: When the Deposed Emperor came to the throne he was posthumously titled grand mentor, his princedom left as before, with the posthumous name Prince Wenzuan.
proposals.reason: 諡曰文宣 is a posthumous name (諡), not a temple name.

proposals.before: Because Gaozu had not taken his mother, Lady Chang, according to proper ritual, he did not permit her to be made princess.
proposals.after: Because his mother, Lady Chang, had not been taken as consort according to proper ritual, Gaozu did not permit her to be made princess.
proposals.reason: 納不以禮 refers to Lady Chang's marriage into the household, not Gaozu taking her; the idiomatic English reverses the agent.

decisions.reason: s0002 enfeoffs 建昌王; Jianchang matches 建昌, while Changchang invents a wrong fief reading.
s0098 dates the famine 延昌初; Yanchang is the correct era reading, not Yanzhang.
及弟臨淮王彧 attaches 弟 to 中山王熙; ‘his’ after ‘He…Xi…’ can misread Yu as Yanming’s brother, so naming Xi as the elder is a real fix.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 與中山王熙及弟臨淮王彧

decisions.reason: 諡曰文宣 is a posthumous name (諡), not a temple name (廟號); replacing ‘temple name’ corrects a terminology error.
高祖以納不以禮，不許其為妃 makes 納不以禮 the ground for Gaozu’s refusal; Gaozu is not the agent who took Lady Chang, so the proposed passive is required.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 高祖以納不以禮，不許其為妃

claimRevisions.reason: Accepted r0001 shows English Prince of Changchang came only from the bad idiomatic of 建昌王; the title claim must read Prince of Jianchang while keeping zh, pinyin, id, subject, predicate, certainty, and evidence.
